note: Small grassland campground in Buffalo Gap National Grassland (Fall River Ranger District), 11.4 mi east of Fairburn on French Creek Rd, then north on FSR 7055. Picnic tables, fire rings and ramadas sit inside a fenced area; rigs park in the gravel lot or on the large mowed area east of it, which horse trailers share (hitching posts). Base for the Fairburn Agate Beds; roads are difficult when wet. Not the Custer State Park French Creek natural area or horse camp. --Claude
